# Vurify

> Vurify helps employers see talent beyond the résumé. Build interview paths for a role, run live interviews, and get structured output that shows who rose and why.

Vurify is an AI-assisted hiring interview platform for organisations: role briefs, candidate intake, live interview stages (talk, forms, coding, writing), and decision-ready output cards.

## Public pages
- https://vurify.org/ — product home
- https://vurify.org/try-interview — public try-an-interview demo
- https://vurify.org/deck — short product presentation

## Product focus
- Structured interview briefs for hiring roles
- Live multi-stage interviews (conversation, assessments, tools)
- Output cards that surface candidate signal beyond the CV
- Organisation workspace for building and running interviews
